rows.output: Ford kuma ta shaida a zaman da ta yi game da zargin da ta yi.
rows.reference: Ford ita ma ta ba shaida a jin bahasin game da ƙagen nata.

rows.output: Shugaban ya ce a ranar Asabar cewa "mutanen Amurka sun ga kyan gani da ingancin da kuma jaruntaka" na Kavanaugh a wannan ranar.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya faɗa a rana Asabar cewa “Amurkawa sun ga fasaha da kyau da ƙarfin hali” na Kavanaugh wannan ranar.

rows.output: "Kuri'ar tabbatar da Alkalin Kavanaugh ita ce kuri'ar tabbatar da daya daga cikin manyan tunanin shari'a na zamanmu, mai shari'a mai kyau tare da cikakken tarihin hidima ga jama'a," ya gaya wa taron masu goyon bayan West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya yi nuni da haka game da zaben da aka yi a baya-baya, yayin da yake magana kan muhimmancin jam'iyyar Republican ta tashi tsaye a zabenaki.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.output: "Satanni biyar ne daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓukan da suka fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina ta guduwa," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.output: "Ina yin haka ne saboda ina ƙoƙarin kare manyan 'yan takara."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat suna da burinsa na "juriya da kuma hana."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.output: An yi tsammani cewa za a yi zabe na farko na tsari a kan bene na Majalisar Dattawan kan gabatar da Kavanaugh ba daga baya ba fiye da Juma'a, wani jami'in shugaban jam'iyyar GOP mai girma ya gaya wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.output: An kashe mutane da dama a cikin girgizar kasa ta Indonesia, tsunami, tare da yawan mamacin da ake sa ran zai karu
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa kuma aka kwashe su yayin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka yi ta shiga bakin teku, bayan da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomin a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi ta jira mutane da dama a wani biki a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka yi ta kawowa a bakin teku a lokacin fadowa, inda suka kai ga mutuwar mutane da dama, kuma suka lalata duk wani abu da ke kan hanyarsu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An bi da tsunami bayan girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazana ta tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su gaggauta gudu ba, kuma sun zama wanda ya yi rauni," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kare bala'i ta Indonesia BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Tsunami ba ya zuwa da kansa, ya ja motoci, itatuwan, gidajen, ya bugi komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, yana ƙara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai fadi da saurin 800 kph (497 mph) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun haura bishiyoyi don su guji tsunami kuma suka tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyin 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jiragen sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata da dama daga cikin gine-gine da shaguna, an karkata da kuma rugujewa gadoji, kuma wani masjid da aka kewaye da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: Rashin jin daɗi ya ci gaba da faruwa a birnin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar Indonesia mai kula da tantancewa da amfani da fasahar (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, karfin da aka saki ta hanyar girgizar kasa mai girma a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 na karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: An ce, yanayin garin, wanda yake a ƙarshen wani kogon mai tsawo da kuma bakin teku, zai iya ƙara girma da girma na tsunami.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai faɗi" kuma ya ce dubunnan gidaje, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawar wasu wanda ya mutu a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 suna bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, ana sa ran asarar rayuka da kuma lalacewar gine-gine za su fi yawa a gabar tekun, kimanin 300 km (190 mil) arewa da Palu, a yankin Donggala, wanda ke kusa da tsakiyar girgizar.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: An katse sadarwa "gaba ɗaya" tare da rashin wani bayani daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai mutane sama da 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin," kungiyar Red Cross ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannnan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya ƙara tabarbarewa."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar kan rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokaci da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin wani faifan bidiyo na masu sha'awar da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na wani gini ana jin yana ihu da gargaɗi cikin hanzari game da tsunami mai gabatowa ga mutane a kan titi.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna kaɗan, katanga na ruwa ya yi ta kutsawa a bakin teku, yana ɗaukar gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: An ba da damar yin amfani da wannan hoton.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Guguwar ta haifar da katsewar wutar lantarki mai girma wanda ya katse hanyoyin sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukumomin da za su tsara aikin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aika jiragen sama masu kaya da agajin da aka samu daga Jakarta da sauran biranen, a cewar hukumomi, amma ‘yan gudun hijira har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran abubuwan da ake buƙata.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: An bude filin jirgin sama na birnin ne kawai don aikin agajin gaggawa kuma zai ci gaba da kasancewa a rufewa har zuwa watan Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya yi shirin ziyartar cibiyoyinsu na baje kolin a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indoneshiya ta fuskanci tsunami mai muni, wanda ya kai sama da 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan World Vision daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikatan ke zama a cikin sansanonin tarpaulin da aka kafa a filin gidan su, sun ga abubuwan da suka lalace a hanya, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Suka gaya min sun ga gidaje da dama da aka lalata," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Koda yake, yayin da ƙungiyoyin agajin gaggawa suka fara aikin da ke da wahala na fara aikin agajin gaggawa, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agajin gaggawa na kasashen waje masu zurfi sun hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesia, ba za a iya fara ba da kudi, kayan aiki da ma'aikata daga kasashen waje ba sai an bayyana wurin bala'in a matsayin yankin bala'i na kasa ba.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu hakan bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne na matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agajin jama'a ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wata matsala ce ta kasa," za mu iya bude domin taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayin ba."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: A lokacin da dare na biyu ya zo Palu bayan girgizar kasa da tsunami da suka faru a ranar Asabar, abokai da 'yan uwa na wadanda har yanzu ba a samu ba suna fatan cewa masu ƙaunarsu za su zama abin al'ajabi da zai sa labarin rashin bege na bala'o'i na halitta ya fi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an cire wani yaro daga cikin wani rami.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ceto wata mata da aka kama a ƙarƙashin tarkacen gini na tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikar mahaifiyarta a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da 'yan paragliding biyu da suka bace don gasar Asiya, wanda ya ƙare a watan da ya gabata a Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Sauran wadanda aka kama a otal din Roa Roa, Mista Mandagi ya hada da dalibai nasa.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban ɗan wasa a fannin paragliding, ina da nauyina na motsa rai," ya ce.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a sa'o'i bayan labarun rugujewar otal din Roa Roa suka yadu a cikin al'ummar paragliding, ya yi wa'azi ta hanyar aikawa da saƙonni ta WhatsApp ga 'yan wasa na Palu, wadanda ke halartan bikin bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙonninsa, duk da haka, ya haifar da alamar duba mai launin toka ɗaya, maimakon alamun shuɗi biyu.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: "Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakonnin ba a kai su ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: An yi sata da dala 26,750 a lokacin da ake cikawa da na'urar caca a Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Ɓarayi sun ɗauki dala 26,750 a lokacin sake cika ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe

rows.output: An yi sata ne a ranar Asabar da safiyar ranar Juma'a, an sace dala 26,750 daga ma’aikaciyar Brink da ke cikin na’ura mai kawowa a Newport on the Levee, a cewar wani sanarwa da hukumar ‘yan sanda ta Newport ta fitar.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: Direban motar ya kasance yana fitar da wani ATM a cikin wurin nishaɗi kuma yana shirya gabatar da ƙarin kudi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum ya yi gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudi da aka yi niyya don isarwa.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun lura da wasu masu zargi da suka gudu daga wurin, a cewar sakin, amma ‘yan sanda ba su bayyana adadin wadanda suka shiga lamarin ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.output: Dukkan mutanen da ke da bayanai game da asusun su su tuntuɓi ‘yan sanda na Newport a 859-292-3680.
rows.reference: Ya kamata duk wani da ke da bayani game da shaidarsu ya tuntuɓi ‘yan sandan Newport a kan 859-292-3680.

rows.output: Yamma, 41, an yi masa laƙabi da Ye na wani lokaci kuma ya yi amfani da wannan sunan a matsayin taken kundinsa na takwas, wanda aka fitar a watan Yuni.

rows.reference: Canjin yana zuwa ne kafin bayyanarsa a cikin shirin Saturday Night Live, inda ake tsammanin zai ƙaddamar da sabon faifansa Yandhi.

rows.output: Ya maye gurbin mawakiya Ariana Grande a kan wasan kwaikwayo wanda ta soke saboda "dalilan motsa rai," kamar yadda maiirin wasan ya ce.

rows.output: Haka kuma yana zama gajeriyar sunan sana'arsa na yanzu, West ya ce kalmar tana da ma'ana ta addini a gare shi.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda ya zama abu gajartacce na sunansa na sana’a na yanzu, West a da ya ce kalmar tana da wata ma’anar addini a gare shi.

rows.output: Na yi imani "kai" shine mafi yawan kalmomin da ake amfani da su a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki, kuma a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki yana nufin "kai," in ji West a baya a wannan shekara, yayin da yake magana da mai gabatar da shirin rediyo Big Boy.
rows.reference: “Na yi imani ‘ye’ kalma ce da aka fi amfani sosai a cikin Baibul, kuma a cikin Baibul tana nufin ‘kai,” inji West a farkon wannan shekarar, yana tattauna sunan faifan ɗinsa tare da mai karɓan baƙi na rediyo Big Boy.

rows.reference: Ya wuce ne daga Kanye, wanda ke nufin guda ɗaya, zuwa kaɗai Ye - kawai wani manuni na kyawunmu, ruɗaninmu, kowane abu.

rows.output: Lamban ya fi zama tunani na ko mu waye."
rows.reference: Faifan kamar wani nuni ne na su wane ne mu.”

rows.output: Yana ɗaya daga cikin shahararrun rappers da suka canza suna.
rows.reference: Yana daga cikin sanannun rappers da suka canza sunansu.

rows.output: Sean Combs an san shi da Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma a wannan shekarar ya sanar da sonansa na suna Love da Brother Love.
rows.reference: An san Sean Combs da sunaye iri-iri a matsayin Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma wannan shekarar ya sanar cewa fifikonsa na sunayen Love da Brother Love ne.

rows.output: Wani tsohon abokin yajin aikin Yammacin Turai, JAY-Z, kuma ya yi amfani da shi ko ba tare da haɗa shi ba da kuma manyan haruffa.
rows.reference: Wani abokin haɗin gwiwa na West, JAY-Z, shi ma ya sha yi da ko ba tare da wani layi gajere na tsakiyar kalma da manyan baƙaƙe.

rows.output: Mexico's AMLO ya yi alkawari ba zai yi amfani da sojojin soji a kan fararen hular ba
rows.reference: AMLO na Mexico ya yi alkawarin ba zai yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba

rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Mexico mai jiran gado, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, ya yi alkawari cewa ba zai taba amfani da karfin soja a kan fararen hular ba yayin da ƙasar ke gab da bikin cika shekaru 50 da tashin hankali da aka yi wa dalibai.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza cewa "ba za a taba amfani da sojojin soji wajen murkushe mutanen Mexico ba."
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: An harbe mutane a yayin da aka yi zanga-zanga a filin wasa a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda aka kashe mutane sama da 300, a lokacin da aka fara samun motsawar daliban hagu a duk fadin Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari zai tallafa wa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar bayar da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda ke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'i na jama'a kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi na jawo matasa zuwa gungun masu laifi.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudaden da take kashewa a fannin fasahar basira
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da China ke kara shiga cikin fasahar basira ta wucin gadi, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka adadin kudi da take kashewa wajen bincike a fannin, in ji mai zuba jari kuma mai aiki da AI, Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: An yi sharhi ne bayan da sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka suka yi sanarwa game da AI, duk da cewa Amurka gaba ɗaya ba ta da wani tsari na hukuma na AI.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A lokacin da, Sin ta gabatar da shirin ta na shekarar da ta gabata: tana da burinta ta zama No.1 a fannin kirkire-kirkire na AI kafin shekarar 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗi na bincike na AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan fara, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashen suna da nisa sosai a bayansa, kuma muna neman gagarumin ci gaba a cikin AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Daidaitawa kuɗin zai iya ƙara yawan damammakin da za a samu a cikin Amurka, in ji Lee a wani hira da CNBC a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: Lee, wanda littafin sa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" ya fito a watan da ya gabata a Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shi ne shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI da ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya zama babban jami'in bincike na Microsoft kuma shugaban reshen Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasa da gwamnati ta Amurka ta yi a baya a fannin fasahar fasaha kamar Gasar Ci gaban Baitulmali ta Robotics da ta yi tambayoyi game da lokacin da za a yi na gaba, don taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana kimiyya a Amurka sau da yawa suna aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasafai Sin ne ke ɗaukar masu jagoranci na ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanoni na fasaha sun dauki masu haske daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekaru da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canje a cikin manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarin ta na ƙirƙirarriyar basira.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina tunanin katunan koren ya kamata su kasance a yi wa PhDs a cikin AI, in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Majalisar Jihohin kasar Sin ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar basirar ɗan adam na zamani a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyyar Halitta ta Kasa ta China tana ba da kuɗin ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi kamar yadda Asusun Kimiyyar Halitta da sauran ƙungiyoyin gwamnati ke fitar da kuɗi ga masu bincike a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa a China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali na Wucin Gadi, wadda aka yi niyya don haɗa ma'aikata daga masana'antu da jami'o'i, kuma Fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓa na Hankali na Wucin Gadi.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jari na dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri mai suna AI Na Gaba.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana zuba sama da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin bincike na AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A lokacin da, dokar Amurka da ke da niyyar kafa wata hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan fasahar kwamfuta ta hanzarta, ba a yi wani abu a cikin watanni ba.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Masedonawa sun yi zabe a kan ko za su canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: Mutanen Masedoniya sun yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza suna zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Masedoniya," wani mataki da zai warware takaddama da ta dore da Girka wanda ya hana neman shiga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Macedonia, tana da'awar cewa sunan makwabta ta arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankin ta, kuma ta hana ta shiga NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatocin biyu sun cim ma yarjejeniyar a watan Yuni bisa sabon sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da ra'ayin kishin kasa sun ce canjin zai gurgunta asalinin al'ummar Slavic mafi yawan jama'ar Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe ba a zaben, kuma yunƙurin da aka yi na yin zanga-zanga a kan zaben ya haifar da shakkun ko za a samu isassun kuri'u 50 cikin 100 da ake buƙata don a yi zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar da aka yi a kan kudurin ta ce: "Shin kana goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka?"
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canjin sunan, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce hakan farashi ne da ya dace da neman shiga kungiyoyin kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, daya daga kasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri'a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya su sami damar rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai saboda tana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga dukkanmu," in ji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a tabbatar da shi a shari'a ba, amma da yawa daga cikin mambobin majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon zabe, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama mai yawa.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake suna zai buƙatar rinjaye biyu bisa uku a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zabe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahotanni na rashin daidaiton zabe ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowarta ta kasance kashi 16%, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34% a zaben majalisar dokoki na 2016 lokacin da kashi 66% na masu rajista suka yi zaɓe.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: Na zo na yi zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu a Turai ne," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi zabe a babban birnin kasar, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka ndị na-eme ihe nkiri"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ ndị AM maka aro na aha ha kwesịrị ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ bụ n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nke ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọasị ya.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-adi na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara ara ma pwp pụtara ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị anabataghị" ma tụnye ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-emeghe uche" gbasara mgbanwe aha, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere okwu okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka okwu Bekee Yorkshire nke mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Kansulu nke Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-edepụta iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ maka ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Ụlọ Nzukọ na-akpọ ga-adị n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Ọchịchị Wales 2017 nyere ndị kansụl Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, kọmịshọna ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke mkparịta ụka ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado siri ike maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'okwu banyere aha AMs, kọmịshọn ahụ kwadoro ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị na nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AMs na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abụ isi ike irute nkwekọrịta ga-abụ ihe na-ewute onye isi oche, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebufe iwu ndị a na-atụ aro n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ahụ ga-agụnyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otu ndị omebe iwu si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara ịkagbu ndị AM na nhazi usoro kọmiti.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enwe votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha ga-akpọ mgbe ha na-eme mkpebi na iwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ụlọ ntuli aka n'ụbọchị ntụli aka nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị na-ahọpụta ndị ga-ahọpụta Sọnde ma ọ bụ gbanwee aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.output: Vootu ndị a ma ama ka e hiwere iji dozie esemokwu ogologo oge na mba ndị gbara ya gburugburu, bụ́ ndị nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.output: Ọ bụ́ Athens na-ekwu na ógbè ugwu ya nwere aha na-ekwu na ọ na-achọ ala ya, ma na-emegide mbọ ya ịbata na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha, kwuru na ya gaaghị ele ya anya.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.output: Otú ọ dị, ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-arụ ụka na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ihe a ga-akwụ ụgwọ iji banye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.output: Mkpọda nke St. Martin's na-adakwasị n'udo ka ụka na Harlem na-alụ ọgụ
rows.reference: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba

rows.output: "N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, ndị okenye m kwuru na e nwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n'akụkụ ọ bụla," Mazị Adams kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.

rows.output: "Taa, enweghị ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”

rows.output: Ọ sịrị na ịla n'iyi nke ụlọ mmanya bụ ihe a naaghị akọwa.
rows.reference: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.

rows.output: "Ndị mmadụ na-akpakọrịta n'ụzọ dị iche iche" ugbu a, o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.

rows.output: "Ọba anaghịzi adị ka ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nke obodo ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga mgbe niile."
rows.reference: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ụlọ ụka, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya na ego sitere na ire ihe onwunwe agaghị adịgide dị ka ndị isi na-atụ anya ya, "ma n'oge na-adịghị anya, ha ga-alaghachi ebe ha si malite."
rows.reference: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”

rows.output: Ụlọ ụka, o kwuru, nwere ike dochie ya na ụlọ elu ụlọ nwere ụlọ ndị nwere ihe ndị ga-enyere obodo ndị fọdụrụ n'ụlọ nsọ aka.
rows.reference: Ndị ụlọ ụka, o tinyere, na enwere ike iji nnukwu ụlọ obibi nwere dochie ha, nke eji ụdị ndị mmadụ na agaghị enyere aka n’ebe nsọ nke gburugburu ahụ fọdụrụ.

rows.output: "Ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ ụlọ n'ụlọ n'ime ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha," ka o kwuru, "na ha ga-eme ka ụlọ ụka ndị a mechie kpamkpam n'ihi na ọ gaghị ekwe omume na ọtụtụ ndị a na-aga n'ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị otu n'ime ụlọ ụka ndị a."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu imirikiti ndị mmadụ na azụta nkewa ụlọ n’ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha, “o kwuru, “ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụbọchị nke ndị ụlọ ụka a ga-emechi kpamkpam bịa ngwangwa n’ihi ọ ga-esi ike imirikiti ndị mmadụ na akwabata n’ime ụlọ ndị a bụrụ ndị otu nke ụlọ ụka ndị a.”

rows.output: Ndị ụka abụọ ahụ wuru ndị otu ọcha tupu Harlem ghọọ obodo ndị ojii - Ụlọ ụka Obodo na 1870, St. Martin's afọ iri ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ụka abụọ ahụ bụ ndị mgbakọ ndị ọcha rụrụ ha tupu Harlem abụrụ obodo ndị isi ojii - Ogbe Obodo Ukwuu na 1870, St. Martin bụ afọ iri ka emechara.

rows.output: Ndị otu ụka Methodist ọcha mbụ kwagara n’afọ 1930.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị Methodist nke izizi pụrụ na 1930.

rows.output: Òtù Ndị Kraịst ojii nke na-efe ofufe n'akụkụ ahụ weghara ụlọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị isii ojii nọ na efe ofufe n’akụkụ wegara aha n’ụlọ ahụ.

rows.output: N'ime St. Martin, ndị otu ojii n'okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson weghara ya, bụ onye duru ndị ahịa na 125th Street, okporo ụzọ azụmahịa bụ isi na Harlem, bụ ndị na-emegide ịrara ma ọ bụ ịkwalite ndị ojii.
rows.reference: Ndị ọgbakọ isi ojii weghara St. Martin n’okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson, onye duru mgbochi nke ndị mgbere ahịa dị na Okporo Ụzọ 125, isi okporo ụzọ maka ịzụ ahịa dị na Harlem, ndị gbochiri ịwere ma ọ bụ ịkwado ndị isi ojii n’ahịa.

rows.output: Mgbọ na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nke ukwuu, ma ka ndị parish nke Father Johnson na-eme atụmatụ imeghari, ha nyere iwu ka a na-arụ ọrụ carillon.
rows.reference: Ọkụ gbara na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nnukwu, mana ka ndị ụka nke Fada Johnson haziri ịrụgharị ụlọ ahụ, ha rụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ.

rows.output: Onye ụkọchukwu David Johnson, nwa nna Johnson na onye ga-anọchi ya na St. Martin's, nwere obi ụtọ na-akpọ ụgbọ ala ahụ "akụkọ ndị ogbenye."
rows.reference: Rev. David Johnson, nwa Fada Johnson yana onye nọchiri na St. Martin, ji obi aṅụrị kpọọ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ “mgbịrịmgba nke ndị ogbenye.”

rows.output: Onye ọkachamara nke na-egwu carillon n'ọnwa Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: "ihe nketa omenala" na "ngwá egwu akụkọ ihe mere eme na-adịghị dochie anya."
rows.reference: Ọkachamara onye kụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ na Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: “Akụ omenala” yana “akụrụngwa akụkọ ihe mere eme enweghị ike idochi.”

rows.output: Onye ọkachamara, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum Michigan, kwuru na ọ bụ ụgbọ ala mbụ n'ụwa nke ndị na-egwu egwu ojii, Dionisio A. Lind, na-egwu, onye kwagara n'ụgbọala buru ibu n'ụlọ ụka Riverside afọ iri na asatọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọkachamara ahụ, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum nke Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ igwe mgbịrịmgba izizi dị n’ụwa nke onye egwu isi ojii ga-akpọ, Dionisio A. Lind, onye nke gara n’igwe mgbịrịmgba ka ibu dị na Ụlọ Ụka Riverside afọ 18 gara aga.

rows.output: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin anaghị dochie ya.
rows.reference: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin anọchighi ya.

rows.output: Ihe mere na St. Martin n'ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga bụ akụkọ mgbagwoju anya nke ndị na-ese ụkpụrụ ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ, ụfọdụ ndị e kpere n'aka ndị isi ụlọ ụka, ndị ọzọ n'aka ndị diọsị nke Episcopalian.
rows.reference: Ihe akpọrọ na St. Martin n’ofe ọnwa ole ma ole gara aga bụ akụkọ nke ndị ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta gbagwojuru anya, ụfọdụ nke ndị ndu nke ụlọ ụka ahụ webatara, ndị ọzọ bụ nke ngalaba ụka dị n’okpuru ọchịchị ndị Bishọpụ.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ - ndị isi ụlọ ụka, nke e ji ndị isi ụlọ ụka na ndị isi obodo mejupụta - dere n'ụlọ ụka n'ọnwa Julaị na nchegbu na ụlọ ụka "ga-achọ ịgafe ụgwọ" n'ụlọ ọrụ, n'agbanyeghị na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ etinyeghị aka na ịhọpụta ndị na-ese ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ụlọ ụka nke ụlọ ụka zigara.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọzụzụ - otu nchịkwa nke ụlọ ụka ahụ, nke ndị ndu juputara - degara ngalaba ụka ahụ na Julaị maka echiche na ngalaba ụka ahụ “ga-achọ ịnyefe ụgwọ ndị ahụ” n’aka ụlọ ozuzu ahụ, ọbụlagodi na ụlọ ozuzu ahụ etinyeghị aka na iwere ndi ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta na ngalaba ụka ahụ ezitere.

rows.reference: Shark merụrụ nwa afọ 13 ahụ na mmanye lọbsta dị na California

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, otu shark wakporo ma merụọ otu nwa nwoke dị afọ 13 ahụ mgbe ọ na-egwu mmiri maka lobster na California n'ụbọchị mmalite nke oge lobster, ndị ọrụ kwuru.
rows.reference: Shark makpuru ma merụọ nwa nwoke afọ 13 ahụ na Satọde ka ọ na amanye na mmiri maka lọbsta na California n’ụbọchị mmepe nke oge lọbsta, ndị ikike kwuru.

rows.reference: Eji ụgbọ elu buru nwa nwoke ahụ gaa Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe edebanyere ya n’ọnọdụ ihe egwu.

rows.output: Onye nche mmiri Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nnọkọ mgbasa ozi na e nwere azụ̀ na mpaghara ahụ izu ole na ole gara aga, ma achọpụtala na ọ bụghị ụdị azụ̀ dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nchịkọta akụkọ na ahụrụ shark na mpaghara ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, mana ekpebiri na ọ bụghị ụdị shark jọrọ njọ.

rows.output: Giles gbakwunyere na onye ahụ merụrụ ahụ merụrụ ahụ n'ụzọ dị egwu n'akụkụ elu nke ahụ ya.
rows.reference: Giles tinyere na onye ahụ ihe mere nwere mmerụ ahụ buru ibu n’akụkụ elu ahụ ya.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ mechiri ụzọ ịbata n'ụsọ osimiri site na Ponto Beach na Casablanca ruo Swami's na Encinitas maka awa 48 maka nyocha na nchekwa.
rows.reference: Ndị ikike mechiri osimiri ahụ bido na Akụkụ Osimiri Ponto dị na Casablad ruo Swami dị na Ecinitas n’ime aka elekere 48 maka ebumnuche nnyocha na nchedo.

rows.output: Atụmatụ Sainsbury's na-abawanye n'ime ahịa ịma mma UK
rows.reference: Atụmatụ nke Sainbury ịbanye n’ahịa ihe ịchọ mma nke UK

rows.output: Sainsbury's na-eweghachi azụ na Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams na ngalabụ ụlọ ahịa nke nwere ebe a na-eme ihe na ndị ọrụ ọkachamara.
rows.reference: Sainbury na eche Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams aka mgba site na iji warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma nwere nka-ụlọ ahịa eji ndị enyemaka ọkachamara kpojuo.

rows.output: Dị ka akụkụ nke mbọ dị ukwuu n'ime ahịa ịma mma UK £ 2.8bn, nke na-aga n'ihu na-eto eto ebe a na-eweghachi ahịa ejiji na ụlọ, a ga-anwale nnukwu ụzọ ịma mma n'ime ụlọ ahịa 11 n'ofe mba ahụ ma were ya gaa n'ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-aga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Dị akụkụ nke ọkpụrụkpụ mbanye n’ime ahịa ihe ịchọ mma £2.8n nke UK, nke na aga n’ihu etolite ebe ahịa uwe na ngwa ụlọ na alaghachi, a ga-anwale warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma n’ime ụlọ ahịa 11 na gburugburu obodo ahụ ma buga ya n’ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n’afọ na esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gaa nke ọma.

rows.output: Itinyekwu ego n'ihe ịchọ mma na-abịa ka ụlọ ahịa na-achọ ụzọ iji jiri oghere shelf ndị e ji mee ihe n'oge gara aga maka TV, igwe ndị na-ekpo ọkụ, na ihe ndị dị n'ụlọ.

rows.output: Ọ bụ ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke nleta onye isi ala Erdogan na Germany, nke bụ nke na-eme ka mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị mmekọ NATO.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke mbịambịa na ebute esemokwu nke Onye Isi Ala Erdogan na Germany- nke ezubere iji dozie mmekọrịta n’etiti ndị enyi NATO.

rows.output: Ha ekewawo n'ihe gbasara ikike mmadụ, nnwere onwe nke mgbasa ozi na nnabata Turkey na EU.
rows.reference: Ha enweela esemokwu n’ihi nsogbu gụnyere ikikere ndị mmadụ, nnwere onwe ndị mgbasa ozi yana mgbakwunye nke Turkey na EU.

rows.output: Erdogan wee gaa Cologne imeghe nnukwu ụlọ alakụba ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ Erdogan gabara Cologne iji mepee ụlọ alakụba ọhụrụ buru oke ibu.

rows.output: Obodo ahụ bụ ebe obibi ndị Turkey kacha ukwuu n'èzí Turkey.
rows.reference: Obodo ahụ bụ ụlọ nke ọnụọgụgụ ndị Turkey kachasị na mpụga nke Turkey.

rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii kwuru na nchekwa bụ ihe kpatara ha ji egbochi iguzogide ndị mmadụ 25,000 n'ihu ụlọ alakụba, ma ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ya pụtara n'akụkụ dị nso ka ha hụ onye isi ha.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii ji n’ihi nche wee gbochie igwe mmadụ ruru 25,000 na ịgbakọta n’ihu ụlọ alakụba ahụ, mana ọtụtụ ndị nkwado pụtara n’ebe dị nso iji hụ onye isi ala ha.

rows.output: Puku ndị na-emegide Erdogan - ọtụtụ n'ime ha bụ ndị Kurdish - kwukwara okwu, na-akatọ ma amụma Erdogan na mkpebi gọọmentị German ịnabatakwa ya n'obodo ahụ.

rows.output: Mmegide ndị na-eme ihe ike na-egosi nkewa nke onye ọbịa a na-asọpụrụ dị ka dike site n'aka ụfọdụ ndị German Turkey na-ewerekwa dị ka onye ọchịchị aka ike site n'aka ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ọgụ ngagharị iwe ahụ na egosi nkewa nke onye ọbịa ụfọdụ ndị Turkey si Germany kpọrọ odogwu n’otu aka ọzọ ndị ọzọ na ahụta ya ka onye ọchịchị akaike.

rows.reference: Ihe mberede ahụ mere n’akụkụ nkwụsị nke Okporo Ụzọ Bestwood na Okporo Ụzọ Evelyn, okporo uzọ na eju eju na Deptford, n’ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ na ndịda nke obodo ahụ, n’ihe dị ka 10:15 BST.

rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ kwụsịrị ma ndị ọrụ ahụike bịara, ma nwoke ahụ nwụrụ n'ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye na anya ụgbọ ala ahụ kwụsịrị, ndị nlekọta letere ya, mana nwoke ahụ nwụrụ n’ebe ahụ.

rows.output: Mgbapụta ahụ na-abịa ọnwa ole na ole ka onye na-agba igwe ọzọ nwụrụ n'ihe mberede na Childers Street, ihe dị ka otu maịlụ site na ihe mberede nke Satọde.
rows.reference: Ihe mberede ahụ na eme n’ime ọnwa ole ma ole ka ọkwọ anyịnya igwe ọzọ nwụrụ n’ihe mberede akụrụ gbapụ ọsọ na Okporo Ụzọ Childers, ihe dị ka otu maịlụ pụọ n’ebe mberede nke Satọde.

rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii Metropolitan kwuru na ndị uwe ojii na-arụ ọrụ iji chọpụta nwoke ahụ ma gwa onye ga-anọchi ya.
rows.reference: Metropolitan Police kwuru na ndị uwe ojii na arụ ọrụ iji mata nwoke ahụ wee gwa onye na esote ya.

rows.output: Mepụta okporo ụzọ na ndị na-anya ụgbọ ala na-eme ka ha ghara ịbịa n'ógbè ahụ.
rows.reference: Mmechi okporo ụzọ na mbugharị nnukwu ụgbọ ala dị, agwala ndị na akwọ ụgbọ ka ha zere mpaghara ahụ.

rows.output: Ụlọ mkpọrọ Long Lartin: Mmadụ isii merụrụ ahụ n'oge ọgba aghara
rows.reference: Ụlọ mkpọrọ Long Lartin: Ndị ọrụ isii merụrụ ahụ n’ọgbaghara

rows.output: Mmadụ isii n'ime ndị ọrụ ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ merụrụ ahụ n'ọgbaaghara dị na ụlọ mkpọrọ ndị ikom nwere nchekwa dị elu, ụlọ ọrụ ụlọ mkpọrọ kwuru.
rows.reference: Ndị ọrụ n’ụlọ mkpọrọ isii emerụọla ahụ n’ọgbaghara dị n’ụlọ nga ụmụ nwoke nwere nnukwu nche, Ụlọ Orụ Ụlọ Mkpọrọ ahụ kwuru.

rows.reference: Ọgbaghara dapụtara na HMP Long Lartin dị na Worcestershire n’ihe dị ka 09:30 BST na Sọnde nke ka na aga n’ihu.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ "Tornado" pụrụ iche e wetere iji dozie nsogbu ahụ, nke gụnyere ndị mkpọrọ asatọ na nke a na-ekpuchi na otu akụkụ.
rows.reference: Akpọbatala ndị ọrụ ọkachamara “Tornado” iji gboo ọgbaghara ahụ, nke gụnyere ndị nga asatọ, akpakọtala ya n’otu akụkụ.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ahụ nwetara ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ dị n'ihu ihu n'ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Eletere ndị ọrụ ahụ maka obere ahụ mmerụ n’ihu ha n’ebe ahụ.

rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ọrụ ndị mkpọrọ kwuru: "Ndị ọrụ ndị mkpọrọ nke a zụrụ n'ụzọ pụrụ iche ka ezipụla iji dozie ihe na-eme ugbu a na HMP Long Lartin.
rows.reference: Onye okwu okwu Ụlọ Orụ Ụlọ Mkpọrọ kwuru: “Ezipula ndị ọrụ ụlọ mkpọrọ azụrụ iche iji gboo ihe ahụ na eme ugbu a na HMP Long Lartin.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ isii enwetala ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Eletela ndị otu isii maka mmerụ ahụ.

rows.output: Anyị anaghị anabatakarị ime ihe ike n'ụlọ mkpọrọ anyị, na anyị doro anya na ndị na-eme ya ga-ezigara ndị uwe ojii ma nwee ike ịnọgide na-ejedebe ogologo oge."
rows.reference: Anyị anaghị anabata ọgbaghara n’ụlọ mkpọrọ anyị, o doro anya na aga enyefe ndị butere ya n’aka ndị uwe oji, ha nwere ike ịnọkwu oge toro ogologo n’ụlọ nga.’

rows.output: HMP Long Lartin na-ejigide ihe karịrị ndị mkpọrọ 500, gụnyere ụfọdụ ndị omekome kacha njọ n'obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: HMP Long Lartin na eji karịa ndị nga 500, gụnyere ụfọdụ ndị omekome kachasị njọ n’obodo a.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, e kwuru na onye nlekọta ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ nwetara ọgwụgwọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ mgbe ndị mkpọrọ wakporo ya.
rows.reference: Na Juun ekpesara na gọvanọ ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ nwetere ọgwụgwọ n’ụlọ ọgwụ ka otu onye nga makpuru ya.

rows.output: Na n'ọnwa Ọktoba nke afọ gara aga, ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọgba aghara ka a kpọrọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ iji dozie nsogbu dị njọ ebe ndị ọrụ ahụ na-awakpo na bọọl mmiri.
rows.reference: N’ọktoba afọ gara aga akpọrọ ndị ọrụ ọgbaghara iji gboo nnukwu nsogbu nke eji bọọlụ siri ike wee makpuo ndị ọrụ.

rows.output: Ogologo ifufe Rosa na-eyi Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City egwu idei mmiri (mpaghara ịkpọ nkụ nwere ike iri uru)
rows.reference: Oke Ifufe Rosa Nwere Ike Ibute Ide Mmiri na Phoenix, Las Vega, Salt Lake City (Mpaghara Ọkọchị Nwere Ike Irite)

rows.output: Ọ na-adịkarị obere ka oke ifufe na-eme n'ala, ma nke ahụ bụ kpọmkwem ihe ga-eme n'isi izu na-abịa ka ike nke Hurricane Rosa na-aga n'ihu n'ofè Desert Southwest, na-ebunye ihe egwu ide mmiri.
rows.reference: O siri ike ịhụ ka oke ifufe egbe-igwe ịkụ Arizona, mana nke ahụ bụ ihe nwere ike ịme na mbido izu na abịa ka ike fọdụrụ na Oke Ifufe Rosa na agafe n’akụkụ Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda nke Ọzara, na ebute ihe egwu ide mmiri.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ihu igwe mba ụwa ewerela ụzọ na-ebufe ihe ndị na-eme ka mmiri na-agba ọsọ na Mọnde na Tuzdee maka mpaghara ọdịda anyanwụ Arizona ruo na ndịda na ọwụwa anyanwụ Nevada, ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ California na Utah, gụnyere obodo ndị dị ka Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, na Salt Lake City.
rows.reference: Ọrụ Ihuigwe Mba enyela nlepụ anya maka ide mmiri maka Mọnde na Tusde maka akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Arizona ruo n’akụkụ ndịda na ọwụwa anyanwụ Nevada, ọwụwa anyanwụ na ndịda nke California na Utah, gụnyere obodo nke Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, na Salt Lake City.

rows.output: A na-atụ anya na Rosa ga-eweghachi ụzọ ozugbo n'elu Phoenix na Tuzdee, na-abịaru n'isi ụtụtụ Mọnde na mmiri ozuzo.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na Rosa ga-agafe Phoenix ozugbo na Tusde, jiri mmiri ozizo na erute na mgbede Mọnde.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ihu igwe mba na Phoenix kwuru na tweet na naanị "mmadụ iri na-ahọpụta oke ifufe ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ mmiri ozuzụ n'ime 200 kilomita nke Phoenix kemgbe 1950!
rows.reference: Ọrụ Ihuigwe Mba dị na Phoenix ekwuola na twit na naanị “oke ifufe ọjọọ iri dịgidere n’ọkwa oke ikuku mmiri ma ọ bụ oke ifufe egbe-igwe n’ime maịlụ 200 nke Phoenix kemgbe 1950!

rows.output: Katrina (1967) bụ oké ifufe n'ime 40 kilomita n'akụkụ ókèala AZ."
rows.reference: Katrina (1967) bụ oke ifufe n’ime maịlụ 40 nke oke ala AZ.”

rows.output: N'ime ihe atụ kachasị ọhụrụ nke National Hurricane Center, a na-atụ anya na mmiri ozuzo ga-adị site na inch 2 ruo 4, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị a na-apụghị iche na inch 6 n'elu Mogollon Rim nke Arizona.
rows.reference: Ụkpụrụ Ọdụ Oke Ifufe Mba kachasị ọhụrụ ugbu a na ebu amụma inchi 2 ruo 4 nke mmiri ozizo, mkpokọta ndị dịpụrụ iche ga-erucha inchi 6 na Mogolllon Rim of Arizona.

rows.output: Mpaghara ndị ọzọ nke Desert Southwest, gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin, nwere ike nweta sentimita 1 ruo 2, na mkpokota ndị a na-apụghị iche na 4 inch.
rows.reference: Mpaghara ndị ọzọ nke Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin nwere ike ịnweta inchi 1 ruo 2, mgbakọta dịpụrụ iche ruru inchi 4 ma enwee ike.

rows.output: Maka ndị na-apụ n'ihe ize ndụ ide mmiri, mmiri ozuzo Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịtụnanya n'ihi na mpaghara ahụ na-agbaze.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ahụ na anọghị n’egwu ide mmiri, mmiri ozizo nke Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ngozi ebe mpaghara ahụ na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na idei mmiri bụ nnukwu nchegbu, akụkụ nke mmiri ozuzo a ga-adịkwa mma n'ihi na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ na-enwe ọnọdụ ọkọchị ugbu a.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị na ide mmiri bụ ihe nnukwu egwu, ụfọdụ mmiri ozizo a ga-adị mkpa ebe akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda ugbu a na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.output: Dị ka U.S. Drought Monitor si kwuo, ihe dị ka pasentị iri anọ nke Arizona na-enwe oke ọkọchị, nke bụ nke abụọ kachasị elu.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị U.S. Ihe Nyocha Ọkọchị, naanị pasentị karịrị 40 na enweta opekata mpe ọkọchị dị oke egwu, otu nke abụọ kachasị,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.output: Nke mbụ, ụzọ nke Hurricane Rosa na-eduga n'ikpughe n'ala n'ofe peninsula Baja California nke Mexico.
rows.reference: Izizi, ụzọ nke Oke Ifufe Rosa na ada n’ofe Baja California ala mmiri nke Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa, ka ọ na-adị n'ike nke ifufe n'ụtụtụ Sọnde, na ifufe kachasị elu nke 85 kilometa kwa elekere, dị 385 kilometa ndịda Punta Eugenia, Mexico, na-aga n'ebe ugwu na 12 kilometa kwa elekere.
rows.reference: Rosa, ka nọrọ n’ike oke ifufe ụtụtụ Mọnde nwere ikuku kachasị nke maịlụ 85 kwa aka elekere, nọ maịlụ 385 ndịda nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico na aga n’akụkụ ugwu na maịlụ 12 kwa aka elekere.

rows.output: Oké ifufe ahụ na-ejupụta na mmiri oyi na Pacific ma na-ebelata ike.
rows.reference: Ikuku mmiri ahụ na abanye mmiri jụrụ oyi na Pacifik ya mere ọ na agbatu n’ike.

rows.output: Ya mere, a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ada n'ala na Mexico n'ikike nke oké ifufe n'ehihie ma ọ bụ mgbede na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Ya mere, atụrụ anya na ọ ga-ada na Mexico n’ike oke ikuku mmiri n’oge ehihie ma ọ bụ mgbede na Mọnde.

rows.output: Mmiri ozuzo n'ofe akụkụ nke Mexico nwere ike ịdị arọ, na-ebute nnukwu ihe egwu ide mmiri.
rows.reference: Mmiri ozizo n’ofe akụkụ nke Mexico nwere ike isi ike, na eyite ihe egwu nke ide mmiri.

rows.output: "Ọ dị ka mmiri ozuzo nke 3 ruo 6 inch ka a na-atụ anya na Baja California ruo n'ebe ugwu Sonora, na ihe ruru 10 inch nwere ike ime," weather.com kọriri.
rows.reference: “Atụrụ anya mgbakọta mmiri ozizo nke inchi 3 ruo 6 sitere na Baja California banye n’akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, nwere ruo inchi 10 ma enwee ike,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.output: Rosa ga-eso n'ebe ugwu n'ofe Mexico dị ka oké ifufe tupu ọ rute na okeala Arizona n'isi ụtụtụ Tuzdee ka oké ifufe, nke ga-esochi n'ebe ugwu site na Arizona na n'ime ndịda Utah n'abalị Tuzdee.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ Rosa ga-aga akụkụ ugwu site na Mexico ka oke ikuku mmiri tupu o rute n’oke ala Arizona n’isi ụtụtụ Tusde ka oke ifufe egbe-igwe, nke ga-agafe ozugbo na Arizona wee banye n’akụkụ ndịda Utah n’oge ime mgbede Tusde.

rows.output: "Ọdachi kachasị mkpa a na-atụ anya site na Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ bụ oke mmiri ozuzo na Baja California, ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Sonora, na mpaghara Southwest U.S. Desert," National Hurricane Center kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ihe ịze ndụ kachasị atụrụ anya n’aka Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ na ya bụ nnukwu mmiri ozizo dị egwu na Baja California, ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, yana U.S. Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara,” Ọdụ Oke Ifufe Mba kwuru.

rows.output: A na-atụ anya na mmiri ozuzo ndị a ga-emepụta idei mmiri na-efe efe na mmiri na-efe efe n'ime ọhịa, na ala na-ada n'elu ugwu.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya mmiri ozizo ndị a ịmepụta ịde mmiri nwere ike igbu ndị mmadụ yana ọsụsọ ahịhịa n’ọzara, yana ala ọzịze n’ala ugwu.

rows.output: Midsomer Norton mwakpo: Mmadụ anọ e jidere maka ịnwale igbu mmadụ

rows.output: Mmadụ atọ nọ n'afọ iri na ụma na otu nwoke dị afọ iri abụọ ka a na-enyo enyo maka ịnwale igbu mmadụ mgbe a chọtara otu onye dị afọ iri na isii nwere mgbaji n'ahụ́ n'obí Somerset.
rows.reference: Ejidela ụmụ ntorobịa nwoke atọ yana otu nwoke dị afọ 20 na nyocha nke ọnwụnwa igbu mmadụ ka ahụchara otu onye dị afọ 16 nwere ọnya eji mma mee na Somerset.

rows.output: Nwata nwoke na-eto eto merụrụ ahụ n'ógbè Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, ihe dị ka elekere anọ nke ụtụtụ na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ nwoke ntorobịa ahụ ebe ọ nwere ọnya n’ebe mpaghara Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, ihe dị ka 04:00 BST na Satode.

rows.output: E were ya n'ụlọ ọgwụ ebe ọ ka nọ n'ọnọdụ "dị n'otu".

rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ iri na asaa, ndị dị afọ iri na asatọ abụọ na otu nwoke dị afọ iri abụọ ka a nwudoro n'abalị a n'ógbè Radstock, ndị uwe ojii Avon na Somerset kwuru.
rows.reference: Ejidere otu onye afọ 17, mmadụ abụọ afọ 18 yana otu nwoke afọ 20 n’abalị na mpaghara Radstock, Avon nke Ndị Uwe Ojii Somerset kwuru.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ahụ agbalịwo ka onye ọ bụla nke nwere ihe nkiri ekwentị ọ bụla nke ihe mere mee ka ọ bịa.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii arịọla ka mmadụ ọ bụla nwere nseta ekwentị mkpanaka nke ihe mere ka ọ bịa ihu.

rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh 'na-ata ahụhụ, obi ọjọọ, iwe nke otu Democratic Party'

rows.output: N'afọ a, ndị agha nchekwa nke U.S. hiwere ebe a na-eme ihe n'ụzọ dị iche iche, nke e mere iji tinye ndị mmekọ site na ụlọ ọrụ na mahadum, na White House kwuputara nhọpụta nke Kọmitii Nhọpụta na Artificial Intelligence.
rows.reference: Na mbido afọ a ndị U.S. Ngalaba Nchedo mepụtara Njikọ Ọdụ Amamịghe Echiche, nke kwesịrị ijikọta ndị mmekọ si na ụlọ ọrụ yana agụmakwụkwọ, ndị White House kwuputere nhazi nke Ọgbakọ Ahọpụtara na Amamịghe Echiche.

rows.output: Na ọnwa a, DARPA kwuputara itinye ego ijeri $2 na mmemme a na-akpọ AI Next.
rows.reference: N’ọnwa a DARPA kwuputere ntinye ego ijeri $2 n’ihe ọhụrụ akpọrọ AI Next.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara NSF, ọ na-etinye ihe karịrị nde $100 kwa afọ n'ịchọpụta AI.
rows.reference: Maka NSF, ugbu a ọ na etinye karịa nde $100 kwa afọ na nyocha AI.

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, iwu U.S. nke bu n'obi ịmepụta National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence enweghị ihe mere n'ime ọnwa.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, iwu U.S. chọrọ ịmepụta Ọgbakọ Nchedo Mba maka Amamịghe Echiche arụbeghị ọrụ ọ bụla n’ọtụtụ ọnwa.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-eme ntuli aka na referendum banyere ma ọ ga-agbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia na atuli aka na nhọpụta ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ya

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia mere ntụli aka na Sọnde na ha ga-agbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia," nke ga-edozigharị esemokwu dị ogologo oge na Gris nke gọnarịrị nnabata ya na European Union na NATO.
rows.reference: Ndị nke Macedonia tulili aka na nhọpụta na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha ya ka ọ bụrụ “Repọblik nke North Macedonia,” ihe ga-ekpezi esemokwu nọgoro ọtụtụ afọ n’etiti Greece ndị gbochigoro arịrịọ nsonye ya maka European Union na NATO.

rows.output: Greece, nke nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia, na-ekwu na aha ógbè ya na-anọchi anya nkwupụta na ha nwere ala ya ma na-egbochi ya ịbanye na NATO na EU.
rows.reference: Greece, nke nwere ogige akpọrọ Macedonia, na ekwusi ike na aha agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, o gbochiela mbanye ya na NATO yana EU.

rows.output: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ mere nkwekọrịta n'ọnwa Jun afọ ahụ dabere na aha ọhụrụ a tụrụ aro, ma ndị na-emegide ọchịchị na-emegide na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emerụ njirimara agbụrụ nke ndị Slavic na-achị Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ rutere nkwekọrịta na Juun dabere na aha ọhụrụ atụnyere, mana ndị iro bụ obodo n’isi na arụrịta ụka na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emebi njirimara agbụrụ nke ọnụọgụgụ ndị Slavic kachasị nke Macedonia.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwupụtala na ọ gaghị eme ntụli aka na ntụli aka ahụ ma otu ndị na-akwado boycott na-eme ka obi sie ya ike ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ezute ihe kacha nta 50 pasentị achọrọ maka ntụli aka ahụ ka ọ bụrụ nke ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwuola na ọ gaghị atuli aka na nhọpụta ahụ, ọzọkwa mgbasa ozi mgbochi etinyela obi mgbagha ma ndị ga-apụta a ga-erukwa pasentị 50 achọrọ pekarịsịrị maka nhọpụta ahụ ịdị ire.

rows.output: Ajụjụ dị na votu referendum bụ: "Ị ga-amasị NATO na EU na nnabata nkwekọrịta na Gris."
rows.reference: Ajụjụ dị n’akwụkwọ nhọpụta ahụ gụrụ: “Ị kwụnyere nsonye NATO na EU site na ịnabata nkwekọrịta dị n’etiti Greece.”

rows.output: Ndị na-akwado mgbanwe aha, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-arụ ụka na ọ bụ ihe dị mma ịkwụ ụgwọ iji chụsoo nnabata n'ime òtù dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n'ime mba ndị pụtara site na ịpụta Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Ndị na akwado mgbanwe aha ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrịta ụka na ọ bụ ụgwọ ekwesịrị ịkwụ iji sochie nnabata n’ewumewu ndị dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n’ime obodo ndị pụtara n’ọdịda nke Yugoslavia.

rows.output: "Abịara m taa ịtọ vootu maka ọdịnihu nke mba ahụ, maka ndị na-eto eto na Macedonia ka ha wee nwee ike ibikọ n'efu n'okpuru umbrella nke European Union n'ihi na ọ pụtara na ndụ ndị anyị ga-adị mma." Olivera Georgijevska, 79, na Skopje.
rows.reference: “Abịara m taa ituli aka maka ọdịnihu nke obodo anyị, maka ndị ntorobịa nọ na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi ndụ otu ha chọrọ n’okpuru nche nke European Union n’ihi ọ pụtara ndụ ka mma maka anyị niile,” nke Olivera Georgijevska kwuru, 79, na Skopje.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụghị iwu kwadoro, ndị otu ụlọ omebe iwu zuru oke ekwenyere na ha ga-azọpụta ihe si na votu ahụ pụta, nke mere ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-ewuli elu.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọdịghị n’okpuru iwu, ndị otu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu zuru oke ekwuola na ha ga-asọpụrụ ndapụta nke ntuli aka ahụ iji mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị mkpa.

rows.output: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ọtụtụ ndị omebe iwu abụọ n'ụzọ atọ n'ime ụlọ omebe iwu.
rows.reference: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ụzọ abụọ n’ọkara ụzọ atọ nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu dị ukwuu.

rows.output: Kansulu steeti ahụ kwuru na ọ nweghị akụkọ banyere ihe na-adịghị mma n'ehihie.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ntuli aka steeti kwuru na enwebeghị mkpesa nke mpụ n’ebe 1 ehihie.

rows.output: Otú ọ dị, ntụli aka bụ naanị pasentị iri na isii, ma e jiri ya tụnyere pasentị iri atọ na anọ na ntuli aka ndị omebe iwu gara aga na 2016 mgbe pasentị iri isii na isii nke ndị debanyere aha ha mere ntụli aka.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mpụta dị naanị na pasentị 16, tụlee pasentị 34 na ntuli aka nzụkọ ọmeiwu gara aga na 2016 mgbe pasentị 66 nke ndị ntuli aka edebanyere n’akwụkwọ tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha.

rows.output: "Agara m n'ime ka m wee votu maka ụmụ m, ebe anyị nọ na Europe," Gjose Tanevski, 62, onye na-eme ntuli aka n'isi obodo, Skopje, kwuru.
rows.reference: “Apụtara m ituli aka n’ihi ụmụaka m, ọnọdụ anyị bụ na Europe,” ka Gjose Tanevski kwuru, 62, onye ntuli aka n’isi ala, Skopje.
